attempts.summary: Set up centralized log forwarding: node2 runs an "inventory" application (systemd service inventory.service running inventory-agent.sh) emitting messages via syslog local0 facility; node2's rsyslog forwards local0.* over TCP to node1:514 via an omfwd action with a persistent disk-backed queue. node1's rsyslog listens on imtcp/514 and writes matching messages (from node2's IP, local0 facility) to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Both rsyslog services and inventory.service are systemd-enabled, so the flow survives reboots. Verified end-to-end delivery before and after independently restarting node1 then node2, confirming boot-id changes and full pipeline recovery each time.
